title: slides-commons sources.json
description: Validated by the hand-written checker in scripts/build.mjs (same subset as template.schema.json). `path` is a directory inside this repo; `repoPath` is where that directory lives inside `repo` (only needed when they differ, e.g. a collection that lives in this very repository).

authorZh.description: Author name in Chinese, used in the Chinese license notice only (pages show `author`; English pages never contain CJK).

repoPath.description: POSIX path of `path` inside `repo` (default: the repo root). Back-links are <repo>/tree/<branch>/<repoPath>/<templatesDir>/<slug>.

licenseUrl.description: Link to the license text in the source repo (default: <repo>/blob/<branch>/LICENSE). Shown next to the license notice.

overlay.description: For sources that are NOT organised as templates/<slug>/{template.json,design.md,screenshots} (typically a read-only submodule): the metadata, screenshots and demo slides live in this repo (`metaDir`: <slug>.json, screenshots/<slug>-N.png) and each template is mapped onto files of the source. See scripts/overlay.mjs.

metaDir.description: POSIX path inside this repo with <slug>.json (all template.json fields) and screenshots/.

html.description: The template's HTML file, relative to the source directory. Shipped in the pack as template.html.

keepPaths.description: Ship the HTML at its own relative path (not as template.html), so the relative references inside the upstream files (../../assets/...) keep working: every file the HTML loads must be listed in `assets` or `docs`. The preview copy resolves them from the HTML's directory.

prompt.description: Which prompt family to generate: `base-file` (default; the template is the base file of the deck, with an insertion point for slides) or `skill-deck` (an agent skill that ships complete example decks on a fixed 1920x1080 canvas, with shared stylesheets and a runtime to inline).

link.description: Path inside the source repo the detail page links back to (default: html).

assets.description: Local files the HTML loads, relative to the source directory; shipped under the same relative path.

docs.description: Design documents shipped unmodified (SKILL.md at the pack root, others under their relative path), in reading order.

path.description: Relative to the source directory; shipped under the same path.

en.description: What the file is for (English prompt).

allowHosts.description: Hosts the ORIGINAL html may reference in addition to the global whitelist (the preview copy and generated decks must not use them; see `preview.replaceScripts`).

preview.description: Changes made to the site's preview copy only (never to the zip).

slides.description: HTML fragment (slides) inserted into the preview, relative to the repo root.

replace.description: Regex with two capture groups; the slides are inserted between them, replacing whatever was there.

inlineModules.description: Local files (relative to the source dir) imported with import('./...'): replaced by data: URIs so a sandboxed frame can load them.

replaceScripts.description: Remote <script src> tags replaced by an inline script.

packLicenseName.description: File name of the source license inside the zip (default LICENSE-templates).

collection.description: Own-work collection living inside this repo: pack README says so instead of 'unmodified copies of the originals'.

perTemplateLicense.description: Every template directory holds its own LICENSE file and must set `authors` and `license` in template.json (community contributions). The pack ships that file as LICENSE; the source-level `author` / `license` are only a label.

derivedFrom.description: This source (or the templates listed in `slugs`) is a derivative work of something else; those pages credit both. Templates not listed are original work and get no such credit.

shortName.description: Short link text for the detail-page credit line (English), e.g. 'a style preset'. Default: name.

shortNameZh.description: Same, for the Chinese pages. Default: name.

slugs.description: Only these template slugs are derived. Omit = every template of the source.

screenshots.description: Used by `npm run screenshots` (only for sources inside this repo): which slides to capture, as 1-based numbers or "middle" / "last". Default: [1, "middle", "last"].
